🚀 weft-loom | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating and performing algorithmic music through a visual interface that is directly linked to code.
✨ Key Features: • Visual music creation with step grids and piano rolls linked to Strudel code • Sound browser for selecting, recording, and importing sounds • Song panel for arranging patterns and creating variations • Live performance features with keyboard input
📖 Summary: Weft Loom is a free, open-source desktop application for creating pattern-based music using Strudel. It offers a visual interface with step grids and piano rolls that directly correspond to and can rewrite the underlying Strudel code, allowing users to create music without extensive coding or to easily modify existing code.
